meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商视频营销创作技能，支持多品类商品的营销视频脚本生成，包含6阶段创作流程、智能体提示词框架、8种商品类型模板，适用于电商平台、社交媒体、品牌推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成电商营销视频脚本，覆盖多品类商品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商商品快速生成营销视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Generate ecommerce marketing video scripts for multiple product categories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create marketing video scripts for ecommerce products

howto.what: 按6阶段流程为商品生成营销视频脚本：先收集商品、平台、时长等需求，再定义人群与风格，提炼卖点，按“痛点→产品→解决”写出脚本，并附镜头、运镜和后期建议。
howto.when: 当你说要为某个商品创作营销视频脚本，或想要电商视频营销的专业指导时，这项技能会被触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个30秒的自动喂食器营销视频脚本，面向都市白领
say.note: 会按6阶段流程生成脚本

say.text: 给这款智能厨电做一个60秒视频脚本，风格要科技感
say.note: 生成带镜头设计的脚本

say.text: 我这款护肤品想做美妆类视频，怎么设计镜头和运镜？
say.note: 返回镜头语言与运镜建议

howto.what_en: When you ask for a product marketing video, it follows a 6-stage workflow: gather product/platform/duration info, define audience and style, extract selling points, write a script with pain-point→product→solution structure, and add shot, camera-movement, and post-production suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say you need a marketing video script for a product, or when you ask for professional e-commerce video marketing guidance.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second marketing video script for an auto feeder, targeting urban office workers.
say_en.note: It will generate the script via the 6-stage process.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second video script for this smart kitchen appliance with a tech style.
say_en.note: It produces a script with shot design.

say_en.text: How should I design shots and camera moves for this skincare product video?
say_en.note: Returns camera language and movement advice.
